description: Swarm at the Rim Outpost: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Machines have come to {station} at the edge of {system}. They are not talking. {client} wants the outpost held until relief arrives. The swarm will keep coming. Do not let it reach the station.
Rogue machines have found the outpost and are attacking it. They do not stop and they do not ask for terms. {client} pays for every minute you hold {station}.
The rim is bad this season. A swarm is hitting {station}. Keep it off the outpost.
success: The swarm fails and what is left drifts away in silence. {client} pays {captain} and the outpost crew stand on the dock and watch you leave.
The outpost still stands. {client} pays and asks that you not describe the swarm in public.
The last drone goes quiet. {client} pays and sends engineers to look at what remains.
failure: The outpost goes dark. {client} pays nothing and wishes it had not asked.
The swarm overruns {station}. {client} withdraws the offer and the crew.
radio-scouts: Drones from the outer dark. Six of them. They will not respond to hails.
Contacts, small and fast. Rogue machines.
radio-swarm: Larger group coming. Ten drones and three heavier shapes.
More of them. They are heading for the outpost.
radio-hunter: Something large behind us. A hunter-class machine, with escorts.
Frigate-sized contact. It has been waiting for us to get tired.
Big machine on the stern. Break it.
radio-last: A last group, high. They are still coming.
More drones above. The swarm is not finished.
Last wave. It is a big one.
